god.en: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
god.zh: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

gold.en: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.

guy.en: Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
guy.zh: 当女性跟一个男人吃饭时，女性会吃得比较少。

grab.en: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?

golf.en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
golf.zh: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。

gray.en: My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.
gray.zh: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。

gun.en: Tom said that he keeps a gun in his home.
gun.zh: 汤姆说他的家里有把枪。

genius.en: He thought that he was a genius.

grateful.en: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
grateful.zh: 如果你能教我怎么做，我会很感激。

generous.en: I don't think that Tom was as generous as he should've been.

garage.en: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
garage.zh: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。

guide.en: Tom has a guide dog named Cookie.
guide.zh: 汤姆有一只导盲犬，名叫曲奇。

gain.en: They tried very hard to gain an advantage over one another.
gain.zh: 他们很努力地超过对方获得优势。

guilty.en: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
guilty.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

guitar.en: When I came home, my sister was playing the guitar.
guitar.zh: 当我回到家的时候，我妹妹正在弹吉他。

guilt.en: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
guilt.zh: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

grandfather.en: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.
grandfather.zh: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。

goal.en: He never gave up hope that he would reach that goal.
goal.zh: 他从没放弃达成那个目标的希望。

garlic.en: The food tasted slightly of garlic.
garlic.zh: 这个食物尝起来有一点大蒜味。

grape.en: That isn't wine. It's grape juice.
grape.zh: 这不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。

goods.en: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
goods.zh: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。

german.en: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
german.zh: 不提英语，他还会说德语和法语。

gas.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
gas.zh: 这场爆炸有可能是瓦斯外泄引起的。

generally.en: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
generally.zh: 通常学生们喜欢理解他们问题的老师。

ginger.en: I hate the taste of ginger.

grandmother.en: My grandmother mailed the letter this morning.
grandmother.zh: 今天早上我祖母寄出了这封信。

gather.en: I gather that they'll agree with us.
gather.zh: 我猜想他们会同意我们的。

germany.en: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
germany.zh: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

grandson.en: My grandson is still a baby.

gum.en: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
gum.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

ghost.en: You look like you've just seen a ghost.
ghost.zh: 你看起来就像见鬼了一样。

gentle.en: She gave the door a gentle push.

graduate.en: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
graduate.zh: 汤姆将在后年高中毕业。

gay.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
gay.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。

grasp.en: He has a good grasp of English.

grammar.en: In Esperanto there are only 16 grammar rules.
grammar.zh: 世界语只有16个语法规则。

gang.en: The gang was planning a robbery.

grave.en: She carried that habit to her grave.
grave.zh: 她到死都改不了那个习惯。

global.zh: 全球变暖让科学家担心。

gunpowder.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

grammatical.en: He made a few grammatical mistakes.

gentleman.en: The man I saw yesterday was a complete gentleman.
gentleman.zh: 我昨天见到的男人根本是绅士。

government.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
government.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。

globe.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
globe.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。

golden.en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.

genuine.en: This might not be a genuine diamond.

garbage.en: Don't forget to take out the garbage.

gently.en: He put his hand gently on her shoulder.
gently.zh: 他把他的手温柔地放在她的肩上。

guarantee.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
guarantee.zh: 我不能确保这一切会发生。

general.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
general.zh: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。

gravity.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
gravity.zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。

glue.en: Some furniture is put together with glue.
glue.zh: 一些家具是用胶水黏在一起。

generate.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.

greenhouse.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
greenhouse.zh: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。

generation.en: My parents' generation went through the war.
generation.zh: 我父母那一代经历过战争。

genetic.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
genetic.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？

grand.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.

gene.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
gene.zh: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。

grain.en: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.

governor.en: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
governor.zh: 每个人都希望他当选州长。

growth.en: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
growth.zh: 第三季国民生产总值较上一季成长了1％。

gasoline.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.
gasoline.zh: 油价上涨的可能性很高。

greet.en: He was aware that I was around, but didn't come to greet me.
greet.zh: 他注意到我在场，但是没向我打招呼。

greatly.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.
greatly.zh: 令我非常伤心的是她考砸了。

glimpse.en: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.
glimpse.zh: 我从火车车窗瞥见了富士山。

gamble.en: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
gamble.zh: 汤姆失业后，为了排遣郁闷的心情而开始了赌博。
